_meta.description: Phase 7B.6.2 — Human price decision freeze. 8 services APPROVED by human. 27 services remain RESEARCH_PENDING or QUOTE_REQUIRED. production_ready = false on all services. No deployment. Research freeze only.
_meta.provenance_description: Human-calibrated FIXEO pilot price derived from Moroccan market research, standardized scope definition, technical integrity review, and client/artisan dual-fairness analysis.
_meta.canonical_disclaimer: Prix indicatif FIXEO — tarif réel confirmé avec l'artisan avant intervention.
_meta.universal_hard_floor_description: Absolute FIXEO viability hard floor. No FIXEO artisan net may fall below 100 MAD under any combination of commission and standard fuel scenario.
_meta.climatisation_target_floor_description: FIXEO human-calibrated economic policy target for technical climatisation work. Reflects specialist equipment burden, transport of tools/material, technical skill level, longer average intervention duration, refrigeration procedure requirements, and safety/environmental responsibility. This is NOT a statistically established Moroccan artisan cost floor — it is a FIXEO_TECHNICAL_POLICY target.
_meta.blind_recharge_prohibition: ABSOLUTE — No FIXEO-endorsed artisan may offer blind refrigerant top-up without prior leak diagnosis. The canonical refrigerant sequence must be followed: diagnose → pressure check → detect leak → repair leak → vacuum → recharge correct type/quantity → test.
_meta.pump_down_doctrine: Refrigerant venting must NEVER be normalized as acceptable FIXEO procedure. Dismantling must use pump-down (refrigerant recovered into outdoor unit). Where pump-down is not technically possible due to inoperable compressor, the situation must be disclosed and handled per separate procedure — not treated as routine venting.
hors_perimetre_workflow: 4. DECLARE: Cette intervention est HORS PÉRIMÈTRE PRIX FIXEO
5. STATE the additional scope or cost required
7. CONTINUE only after approval — original standardized price must never silently increase
